state: Current unpublished contract; supersedes startup store publication and discovery obligations

ownership.store: Caller-populated passive values with literal defaults and public setters
ownership.preparation: Application startup explicitly calls EnvironmentDefaults.Apply(applicationAssembly), supplies explicit values, then calls EnvironmentOverrides.Apply. Consumers remain application-controlled.
ownership.logging: LoggingOptions.Prepare checks logging values and paths; EventMetadata captures immutable allowlisted facts; runtime work remains the logging module responsibility

concurrency: No atomic multi-property update or live refresh contract; populate before starting consumers.
compatibility: Publication ledger is empty. Historical fixtures/evidence stay intact; these draft signatures may change before release.
initialValues: Literal store defaults do not implement ServiceVersion/BuildVersion coupling, string trimming or discovery fallback. Application startup owns these policies; configuration conformance setup/discovery layers are an explicit reference caller policy.
metadataConsumption: Logging checks required identity, UUID/startup time, valid optional Unicode, OS family, schema-valid architecture text and positive optional process ID. It owns normalized copies without changing the store.

defaultsHelper.precedence: Discovered defaults < explicit supplied assignments < aliases < canonical environment variables
defaultsHelper.buildVersion: Nonblank informational version, then assembly version, then unknown; file version is not used.
defaultsHelper.optionalFailure: Unavailable process start inspection yields null. Other failures propagate; no atomic update contract.
defaultsHelper.repeatedCall: Reapplies discovered facts and generates a new UUID/startup timestamp; no readiness or once-only gate.
defaultsHelper.doesNot: Read environment overrides, inspect the entry assembly implicitly, initialize consumers, validate logging, publish a snapshot or implement live refresh.

status: Historical unpublished passive-store candidate, superseded by user-requested readonly instance construction.
